purpose: reconcile the eligible non-DfT source evidence and pin the invariants that each unresolved external blocker implies

dft.state: real evidence acquired and in use for Manchester local authority 85
dft.reason: DfT is a survey archive; a live state would present a survey from an earlier year as current traffic

webtris.state: historical latest-available workflow accepted for the observed site-day
webtris.ntis_candidate: would require a new Gate A

national_highways.state: operationally accepted for the audited feeds
national_highways.note: the only sources permitted to be near-live, and the freshness policy enforces that exclusivity

bods.state: accepted scoped operator verification for Bee Network membership by identifier
bods.note: the only source permitted to claim a live vehicle observation, and it can still degrade to stale and unavailable

tfgm_signals.note: signal phases, queues and controller timing stay visibly unavailable

unresolved_external_blockers.subject: the DfT raw-count hour carries no stated timezone
unresolved_external_blockers.consequence: the hour is typed as a local clock label and never converted; the profile module is asserted to contain no timezone conversion at all

unresolved_external_blockers.subject: WebTRIS clock semantics are unstated and the feed runs a month in arrears
unresolved_external_blockers.consequence: near-live admission stays rejected; WebTRIS is not eligible for the near_live state

unresolved_external_blockers.subject: retention period and republication permissions are unstated
unresolved_external_blockers.consequence: retention stays fail-closed and no retention default is assumed

documentation_probe.finding: none of the probed official pages resolves the DfT hour timezone, WebTRIS clock semantics, or BODS retention and republication terms
documentation_probe.next_step: direct provider enquiries; the answers cannot be derived from published documentation

what_this_record_does_not_do: it does not close any of the three external blockers
it does not invent a provider reply, a licence term, or a retention period
it does not accept Gate B or advance any capability
it does not claim TfGM signal data, Manchester-wide live private traffic, or complete Bee Network fleet coverage

checks: only the audited National Highways feeds may be near-live, asserted across every source
DfT is historical only and never live
only BODS may claim a live vehicle, and it can still degrade to stale and unavailable
TfGM signals and Randy TOS offer no real state beyond unavailable and synthetic
every source can express unavailability, so no source has to invent a state when evidence is missing
the recorded probes still say what they said: WebTRIS near-live rejected, no credential persisted, no automatic polling, no raw bytes committed
invariants_pinned_in_code.why: these are the invariants that could regress silently. A source quietly promoted to near-live, a credential quietly persisted, or a retention default quietly appearing would each look like progress rather than a defect.
